notes: PB5122 owns the fix (open; its mechanism, the 2023 class-condition operand rule applied at every edition, is this finding; its rule list names GR5's row only). §1985:VI.6.3.1.2 GR3: "An operand is alphabetic-lower if it consists entirely of the lowercase letters a, b, c, ... , z, and space". CobolClass.IsAlphabeticLower is that test (every character is a to z or space; a zero-length operand is false, which is the amended paragraph's zero-length group result), and RenderClass calls it on the operand's character image for a data item of any admitted description: an alphanumeric, alphabetic or alphanumeric edited item, a group (its concatenated image) and a reference-modified slice. The 2023 addition, a locale's LC_CTYPE deciding instead, is unreachable at 85: RenderClass passes the classification argument only when the program has an OBJECT-COMPUTER CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION clause, and VisitCharacterClassificationClause refuses that clause at --std 85 (COBOL0900). Probed at --std 85 on PIC X(6): abcxyz and all spaces are alphabetic-lower; ABCXYZ, AbC yZ, AZaz, a digit, the grave accent and { (the characters that border a to z), LOW-VALUES and HIGH-VALUES are not; NOT inverts each answer; a PIC A item, a group, a PIC XBX item and X (1:1) classify by content. What is NOT implemented is the test of a numeric edited operand. 1985 bars only a numeric item ("The ALPHABETIC-LOWER test cannot be used with an item whose data description describes the item as numeric"), and a numeric edited item is not one (§1985:IV.4.3.3: "The alphanumeric class includes the categories of alphanumeric edited, numeric edited, and alphanumeric (without editing)"), so the rule must be applied to its content; CheckClassConditionOperand asks ClassConditionModel.Violates the 2023 rule (NotBooleanNumericOrNumericEdited, §2023:8.8.4.4.3 SR4) with no edition arm and refuses the condition (COBOL6000). The witness tests a lowercase item with a space (true) and one with a single uppercase letter (false).

next.reason: 1985: "An operand is alphabetic-lower if it consists entirely of the lowercase letters a, b, c, ... , z, and space."; 2023: "If a locale is in effect for character classification, the condition is true if the content ... lowercase alphabetic in locale category LC_CTYPE". Without a locale, 2023 keeps the 1985 rule (a-z and space). It adds a case: with a locale in effect, the LC_CTYPE lowercase characters decide the result instead.
